treatments.dose_text_ms: 2.5 g/L air, rendam pangkal batang dan tanah sekeliling, ulang selepas 14 hari
treatments.source_ref: MPB Panduan Pengurusan Reput Pangkal Lada (metalaxyl-mancozeb combination product label rate)

treatments.dose_text_ms: 2.5-3.0 g/L air, sembur menyeluruh daun dan pangkal batang
treatments.source_ref: DOA Sarawak Extension Guide - Pepper Foot Rot Control (fosetyl-Al systemic fungicide rate)

treatments.dose_text_ms: 1% (10 g kuprum sulfat + 10 g kapur / 1 L air), sembur pangkal batang
treatments.source_ref: MPB Panduan Pengurusan Reput Pangkal Lada (contact fungicide, traditional Bordeaux rate)

treatments.dose_text_ms: 5 g/liang tanaman, gaul dengan tanah sekitar pangkal batang, ulang setiap 3 bulan
treatments.source_ref: MPB Panduan Pengurusan Reput Pangkal Lada (preventive biocontrol, non-rainfast-critical)
